# `m.stocks.short_volume`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Daily short sale volume of US-listed stocks, one row per ticker and trading day.

```python
m.stocks.short_volume(symbols=None, *, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

[All datasets](README.md)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| Time range | `start` and `end` are sent as `date.gte` and `date.lte` |
| `poll()` | holds exactly the latest cycle's rows, keyed by `Symbol` and `Date` (`dm.PollMode.REPLACE`) |
| `sort` | any REST field of the rows (see Massive fields below), or several separated by commas, each with an optional `.asc` or `.desc` |
| `filters` | `short_volume_ratio`, `short_volume_ratio_any_of`, `short_volume_ratio_gt`, `short_volume_ratio_gte`, `short_volume_ratio_lt`, `short_volume_ratio_lte`, `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte` |

## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Short Volume (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily, 2 years |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily, All history |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The primary ticker symbol for the stock." | REST |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST |
| `AdfShortVolume` | long | Short volume reported via the Alternative Display Facility (ADF), excluding exempt volume. | REST |
| `AdfShortVolumeExempt` | long | Short volume reported via ADF that was marked as exempt. | REST |
| `Date` | String | The date of trade activity reported in the format YYYY-MM-DD | REST |
| `ExemptVolume` | double | Portion of short volume that was marked as exempt from regulation SHO. | REST |
| `NasdaqCarteretShortVolume` | long | Short volume reported from Nasdaq's Carteret facility, excluding exempt volume. | REST |
| `NasdaqCarteretShortVolumeExempt` | long | Short volume from Nasdaq Carteret that was marked as exempt. | REST |
| `NasdaqChicagoShortVolume` | long | Short volume reported from Nasdaq's Chicago facility, excluding exempt volume. | REST |
| `NasdaqChicagoShortVolumeExempt` | long | Short volume from Nasdaq Chicago that was marked as exempt. | REST |
| `NonExemptVolume` | double | Portion of short volume that was not exempt from regulation SHO (i.e., short_volume - exempt_volume). | REST |
| `NyseShortVolume` | long | Short volume reported from NYSE facilities, excluding exempt volume. | REST |
| `NyseShortVolumeExempt` | long | Short volume from NYSE facilities that was marked as exempt. | REST |
| `ShortVolume` | double | Total number of shares sold short across all venues for the ticker on the given date. | REST |
| `ShortVolumeRatio` | double | The percentage of total volume that was sold short. Calculated as (short_volume / total_volume) * 100. | REST |
| `TotalVolume` | double | Total reported volume across all venues for the ticker on the given date. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |

`RawSymbol` holds Massive's spelling of a symbol the library cannot read; that row's `Symbol` is null, and `RawSymbol` is null on every other row. A session with `unreadable_symbols=dm.OnError.RAISE` (in code or in the settings file, as `unreadable_symbols: raise`) fails on such a row instead and has no `RawSymbol`; the table shows the default session.
